subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Having a common centre, as circles or spheres
solution:
The correct answer is: **Concentric**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Meanings of the words:
 
 
• 1) **Cylindrical **- having the shape of a cylinder, a three-dimensional shape with circular bases and straight sides.
 
• 2) **Concentric **- having a common center, as circles or spheres.
 
• 3) **Elliptical **- having the shape of an ellipse, a flattened circle or oval shape.
 
• 4) **Centrifugal** - moving or tending to move away from a center.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Concentric.**
